title: Halifax DT579 Memorial, Villeneuve-en-Montagne
memorial_details: Memorial photographed in June 2009 by Thierry Dubois for the Aérostèles French aviation memorial database. Memorial type, precise location, inscription text, and dedication date are held in French-language sources (Aérostèles and France-Crashes 39-45) that were not fully accessible during the research conducted for this record. A French-language research pass is needed before a fuller record can be published.
